user.title: Adaptive Alarm — new configuration
user.description: Create Adaptive Alarm, then configure contacts, groups, vibration, notifications, lights and siren.

abort.already_configured: Adaptive Alarm has already been configured.

init.title: Adaptive Alarm configuration
init.description: Configure protection, vibration, notifications, timing, lights and siren. Physical outputs require explicit opt-in.

menu_option_descriptions.protection: View and manage required contacts and all groups together.
menu_option_descriptions.optional: Add contacts that do not block arming.
menu_option_descriptions.vibrations: Add, edit, or remove any number of sensors, each with its own physical contact.
menu_option_descriptions.deterrent: OFF by default: physical lighting only after explicit opt-in.
menu_option_descriptions.notifications: Choose explicit HA notify targets. Telegram Bot uses notify entities.
menu_option_descriptions.notification_events: Enable each event separately. All events use the destinations configured under Phone notifications.
menu_option_descriptions.notification_test: Send a verification message to configured recipients.
menu_option_descriptions.siren: Configure siren and indicator. Physical output requires explicit opt-in.
menu_option_descriptions.timing: Set exit delay, debounce, window and hit threshold 2 or 3. Protected contacts returning open trigger automatically.

mandatory.title: Mandatory contacts and optional lock
mandatory.description:
All contacts in this list must be closed. If configured, the lock must be locked.

Configured alternative groups:
{groups_summary}

Do not also add the alternative-group contacts as mandatory.

data_description.mandatory: ALL these contacts must be closed. Do not also add contacts already assigned to alternative groups.
data_description.lock: If a lock is configured, it must be locked when the exit delay ends.

group.title: Add or edit a required group (alternatives)
group.description: Create a required OR group: one closed contact is enough to satisfy this group. Use Edit existing group to change its membership.

remove_group.title: Remove a required group
remove_group.description: Select a group to delete. Its contacts leave the protection configuration; unlink any associated vibration sensors first.

optional.title: Optional contacts
optional.description: Optional contacts do not block arming. Closed contacts are protected; initially unreadable contacts can enroll on their first closed observation. Already-open contacts are excluded for the session.

data.optional: Other monitored contacts (not required to arm)

vibrations.title: Vibration sensors (any number)

siren.title: Siren and indicator
siren.description: Select the Zigbee2MQTT siren. Enable physical output only after confirming the device's independent automatic cutoff. The siren activates on alarm and turns off on disarm or at the trigger deadline. Physical output is disabled by default. An input_boolean ON/OFF indicator is optional.

timing.title: Alarm timing and vibration confirmation
timing.description: Set exit delay and triggered duration. After the timeout the system returns to armed_away without discarding protected zones. Configure vibration confirmation. Offline protected zones remain protected and initially unreadable optional zones remain pending.

data.vibration_threshold: Hits from same sensor to trigger (2 or 3)

data_description.arming_delay: Exit countdown before required contacts are checked; 0 = immediate check.
data_description.vibration_threshold: 2 or 3 valid hits from the same sensor. Threshold 1 is not allowed.
data_description.vibration_debounce: Minimum time between hits from the same sensor; closer events are ignored (e.g. 3 s).
data_description.vibration_window: Time in which 2 or 3 valid hits must arrive from the same sensor (e.g. 20 s).
data_description.trigger_duration: Alarm duration before automatic re-arming and siren OFF. Verify the Zigbee device's own automatic cutoff.

vibration_add.title: Add vibration sensor
vibration_add.description: Choose the vibration sensor and its actual physical contact, which must already be monitored.

vibration_edit.title: Edit linked contact
vibration_edit.description: Choose a sensor to edit. To change the source, remove it and add it again.

vibration_edit_contact.title: Vibration physical contact
vibration_edit_contact.description: Select the new physical contact linked to this sensor.

vibration_remove.title: Remove vibration sensor
vibration_remove.description: Removes only this sensor association, without changing the monitored contacts.

deterrent.title: Deterrent lights on first hit (optional)
deterrent.description: To turn on lights at the first valid hit, enable light activation and select light entities. To have them switch OFF after a delay, you must ALSO enable Safe automatic light turn-off: this is a separate option, OFF by default. Choose a delay (120 s default). Adaptive Alarm waits up to 15 s for Home Assistant to confirm the light is ON; if no confirmation arrives, it NEVER blindly switches it off and reports the reason. Lights originally ON, later manually modified or in a triggered alarm are not switched off. Timer ownership is not resumed after restart. Siren is inactive.

data.deterrent_enabled: Enable actual light turn-on at prealert
data.deterrent_auto_off: ALSO enable automatic turn-off after the delay

notifications.title: Phone notifications (HA App, Telegram, others)
notifications.description: OFF by default. Select one or more notify.* entities (including modern Telegram Bot chat targets), or notify.mobile_app_* and other existing HA notify actions. Do not enter Telegram credentials here; configure the bot separately in Home Assistant. Test sends a real message. Accepted service request does not guarantee delivery to the phone.

protection.title: Required contacts and groups
protection.description:
All mandatory contacts must be closed. Every alternative group is required; one closed contact per group is sufficient.

Configured groups:
{groups_summary}

Edit contacts, groups and the lock here. Configuration cannot change while the alarm is armed.

menu_option_descriptions.group_edit: Choose a group and change its contacts.

group_edit.title: Choose a group to edit
group_edit.description: The selected group's name and contacts are pre-filled in the next form.

notification_events.title: Notification events
notification_events.description: Choose which Adaptive Alarm events use the shared Home Assistant recipients configured under Phone notifications. Disable events already notified by Apple Home to avoid duplicates. HomeKit's native alerts are independent.

error.invalid_rules: Duplicate sensors, invalid group or incompatible rule. Each contact may appear only once across mandatory/alternative/optional lists.
error.unpaired_vibration: Every vibration sensor must have a physical contact (and vice versa).
error.invalid_vibration_zone: Linked physical contact must be in monitored contacts.
error.deterrent_no_lights: Select at least one light before enabling deterrence.
error.notification_no_targets: Select at least one target to enable notifications.
error.notification_service_missing: The chosen notify service is not available.
error.invalid_notification_target: Invalid notification target: only notify services/entities are permitted.
error.fake_siren_helper_required: Select an input_boolean for the indicator.
error.invalid_fake_siren_helper: Only a valid input_boolean helper is allowed.
error.siren_entity_required: Select a siren entity before enabling physical output.

abort.active_session: Disarm the alarm before changing protection rules or settings.
abort.unlink_vibration_first: Unlink the vibration sensor from that contact before removing it from the protection rules.
abort.notification_test_sent: Test notification request sent. Check the phone: action success does not guarantee delivery.
abort.notification_test_failed: At least one test destination is missing or returned an error. Check logs.
abort.notification_no_targets: Select at least one target to enable notifications.
abort.invalid_notification_target: Invalid notification target: only notify services/entities are permitted.
